iss.name: International Space Station
iss.source: Effective onboard microgravity, not local gravitational attraction: https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/np-2015-03-018-jsc-cellular-biology-iss-mini-book-508.pdf . Communication delay approximated as zero minutes for this demo (not physically zero); NASA describes negligible/millisecond delays: https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/the-space-network-cell-towers-for-astronauts/

moon.name: Lunar base
moon.source: Surface gravity: https://www1.grc.nasa.gov/beginners-guide-to-aeronautics/moon/ . Mean one-way light time 1.27 seconds converted to minutes: https://www.esa.int/media/ten-things-you-didn-t-know-about-the-moon-moon-calling-earth . Signal travel time only; excludes clinical response and network delays.

mars.name: Mars base
mars.source: Surface gravity: https://www.jpl.nasa.gov/news/press_kits/insight/landing/facts/mars-at-a-glance/ . Demo uses the upper endpoint of NASA's 3-22 minute one-way signal delay, not a constant for all missions: https://science.nasa.gov/blog/speaking-percys-language-how-to-talk-so-perseverance-will-listen/ . Excludes clinical response time and outages.
